title: 第8章 家一第9章 家二
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
胡隆向后靠进座椅深处。
皮革贴合着后背传来沉实的包裹感。
他侧过头，望向车窗外。
绿化带的灌木与乔木连成一片模糊的绿影，飞速向后掠去。
细密的雨丝在玻璃上汇聚成股，蜿蜒淌下，将窗外的世界晕染成一片流动的水色。
更远处，铅灰色的天幕沉沉压着。
湖面被雨点击打出无数细密的涟漪，一圈圈扩散、交错、消失。
隐约能看见几尾鱼浮近水面，口器开合，吞吐着一颗颗气泡。
这一座桥，是湖中心岛屿通往外界唯一道路。
身后那一片建筑群随着距离拉远，在雨雾中变得朦胧起来。
见此。
他收回视线，心中一动，唤出太素面板。
随后，目光落在最下方一栏的位置。
【源值:4.31（缕）】
因为天气原因，这两个月只增长近四点的源值。
他讨厌雨天。
没有阳光，源值便不会增长。
这会拖慢他下载技能、提升自我的进度，而那鬼影的威胁，始终悬在心头，像一根逐渐收紧的丝线。
这次出院，需要尽量想办法将其解决才可。
驾驶座上。

胡昭一边开车，一边透过车内后视镜，悄然看了一眼后座沉默的胡隆。
只见他正望着窗外出神，侧脸在朦胧的光线里显得有些疏淡。
她指尖在方向盘上轻轻敲了一下，终是开口，打破了车厢内那种寂静。
“你……最近还好吗？”
胡隆的思绪被拉回。
他转过脸，望向记忆中这位姐姐。
原身如今二十一岁，对方长他五岁，该是二十六了。
三年过去，胡昭身上少了几分旧日的稚气，添了些许成熟的气息。
可那张脸，却还是从前的模样。
原身的印象里，与其的关系还算亲近，就像是普通的姐弟一般。
会经常打打闹闹。
在原身被送入晨光精神病院的三年，初始她也来探望过几次。
只是后来，原身精神状况急转直下，不想见人，探视便渐渐少了。
他眼波微动，却未起太多波澜，只牵起一个恰到好处的微笑，点了点头。
“感觉挺好，医生说，按时服药，稳定下来就不容易再犯了。”
content_en:
Hu Long leaned back into the seat.
The leather fits the back, giving it a solid wrapping feel.
He turned his head and looked out the car window.
The shrubs and trees in the green belt formed a blur of green shadow and swept back quickly.
Thin raindrops gathered on the glass and flowed down, turning the world outside the window into a flowing water color.
Farther away, the leaden gray sky pressed heavily.
Countless fine ripples were created on the lake surface by the rain, spreading, interlacing, and disappearing in circles.
You can vaguely see a few fish floating close to the water, opening and closing their mouthparts, puffing out bubbles.
This bridge is the only way from the island in the center of the lake to the outside world.
The group of buildings behind them became hazy in the rain and fog as they became farther away.
See this.
He looked away, and with a thought in his heart, he summoned the Taisu panel.
Then, his eyes fell on the bottom column.
[Source value: 4.31 (wisp)]
Due to weather reasons, the source value only increased by nearly four points in the past two months.
He hates rainy days.
Without sunlight, the source value will not grow.
This would slow down his progress in downloading skills and improving himself, and the threat of the ghost always hung in his mind, like a gradually tightening thread.
This time I am discharged from the hospital and I need to try my best to find a way to solve it.
In the driver's seat.
While driving, Hu Zhao quietly glanced at Hu Long, who was silent in the back seat, through the rearview mirror.
I saw him looking out the window in a trance, his profile looking a little distant in the hazy light.
She tapped her fingertips on the steering wheel and finally spoke, breaking the silence in the car.
"Are you...how are you lately?"
Hu Long's thoughts were brought back.
He turned around and looked at the sister in his memory.
The original person is now twenty-one years old, and the other person is five years older than him, so he should be twenty-six.
Three years have passed, and Hu Zhao has lost a bit of his old childishness and gained a bit of maturity.
But that face is still the same as before.
In the original impression, the relationship with him was quite close, just like an ordinary brother and sister.
There will be frequent fights.
During the three years when the original person was sent to Chenguang Mental Hospital, she came to visit a few times in the beginning.
But later on, the original person's mental condition deteriorated rapidly and he didn't want to see anyone, so his visits gradually became less and less.
His eyes moved slightly, but it didn't cause too much trouble. He only gave a well-placed smile and nodded.
"I feel pretty good. The doctor said that if you take the medicine on time, it will be less likely to happen again when it stabilizes."
